summary: DevvStream Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing a binding term sheet for a $6 million private placement of Series A Non-Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock to EEME Energy SPV I, LLC. The perpetual preferred shares rank senior to common stock in dividends and liquidation. Proceeds will partly fund an investment in Southern Energy Renewables, Inc., tied to a Business Combination Agreement. The filing is a routine financing agreement and does not evidence a change of control, operational restructuring, or strategic event. It is classified as none because it represents ordinary capital raising without triggering a special-situation category.
